description: The MH-14 RTO serves the Pimpri-Chinchwad industrial hub and twin cities within the Pune district. It functions as a Deputy RTO office primarily handling vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport permits for the PCMC area. This office was established to alleviate the workload of the main Pune RTO (MH-12) due to the region's massive industrial growth.
address: Purna Complex, A Wing, Opposite Telco Gate, Chikhali Road, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Pune, Maharashtra
